children.innerHTML: Everything the label does when it isn't pressing its own records: the studio, the desk, and the Thursday ritual of listening to yours.
A live room, a 1978 desk, and every microphone we have ever refused to sell.
Mastered for vinyl first, streaming second. Loud, but never sorry.
We broker 300-to-500-copy runs for other labels at the plant that knows us.
Thursday, 8:04 pm. Demo number three, needle down.
Send three songs. Not your best three, your truest three. We listen every Thursday with the lights off and the phones in a drawer.
MP3 is fine. Modesty is not.
